column1: # Second blind holdout for the print italic reserve, written 2026-11-23T18:36Z before any Excel export of
# Why a second holdout: the first (print-italic-holdout-predictions.tsv) preregistered floor(floor(winAscent*h/upm)/5)
# and Georgia 15 at 100 % observed 2.75 against a 2.64 prediction (fail). The revised variant below uses
# round(winAscent*h/upm) before the /5 floor, chosen after that failure; this workbook is its blind test.
# Model used for these predictions: reserve = floor(round(usWinAscent x round(points x scale x 600/72) / upm) / 5) x 72/600 pt.
# Metric and device identical to the first holdout: Poppler word-box xMax to the printed #FFF2CC fill's right edge;
# Microsoft Print to PDF, Microsoft Print To PDF driver, PORTPROMPT:, 600 x 600 dpi, Excel 2019 direct export.
